arguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Generate ONE isolated Cartoon game sprite for the supplied source frame. Image1 is the exact original and controls pose, wing angle, facing, eye visibility and cloth placement. Image2 supplies the gull's materials only: white head/body, light gray feathers, dark wing tips, warm yellow beak, crisp black outlines and restrained cel shading. Image3 supplies the ragged white cloth with pale cool-gray folds only, NOT its side-view shape or length.
Subject: ONE gull flying almost straight TOWARD the viewer while carrying a small foreshortened bundle of white clothes immediately underneath its beak. It has two visible eyes looking forward, a compact front-facing beak gripping the top of the cloth, and two wings. The body is foreshortened behind the head, not in side profile. The white cloth must be a compact irregular flattened/oval folded bundle below the head like the source; most of its length is hidden behind through foreshortening. No long hanging scarf or streamer, no gigantic shorts. The bundle and its beak grip must read clearly as cloth separate from the gull. Feet are tucked and occluded in this head-on view; do not invent dangling legs or hands.
Wing phase: The wings sweep DOWN and outward, forming an inverted wide V, with both pointed wing tips lower than the cloth bundle. The central body trails back and slightly upward behind the head. Keep the subtle diagonal front view rather than a perfectly symmetrical heraldic bird.
Keep the whole bird and cloth visible with at least six percent transparent space around all extremities. Smooth clean Cartoon inkwork, no pixelation. Genuinely transparent RGBA background. No ground, shadows, scenery, checkerboard, glow, labels or text. No extra birds, limbs or cloth props. Render only one frame.
